title: Security
description: Passkeys let you verify your identity with your device (fingerprint, face or security key) instead of a code.
caption: Your passkeys
col.name: Name
empty.title: You have no passkeys yet
empty.description: A passkey lets you verify your identity with your device (fingerprint, face or security key) instead of typing a code. Your authenticator app code keeps working whether or not you add one.
unsupported.message: This browser or device does not support passkeys, so you cannot add one here. Your authenticator app code keeps working.
add.title: Add a passkey
add.description: Give it a name that helps you recognize this device, then follow your browser's prompt.
add.name: Passkey name
add.cancelled: The passkey prompt was cancelled. Nothing was added.
add.limit: You reached the maximum of 10 passkeys. Remove one to add another.
add.alreadyRegistered: This device already has a passkey registered for your account.
add.failed: We could not create a passkey on this device. Try again or use another device.
remove.title: Remove this passkey?
remove.description: The passkey {{name}} will stop working. You can still use your authenticator app code.
